_note: Taken from the public tour pages of viajarporescocia.com on 26 Nov 2026 (same itinerary for the three brands) plus the Bókun product IDs provided by Sergio. Still unverified. Known gaps: (1) `days` only lists stops that already exist as Places, so the mainland stops are only named in each day's summary: (Glencoe, Glenfinnan, Eilean Donan, Loch Ness, Inverness, Pitlochry…) and Lealt Falls are missing, and days 1 and 3 of the 3-day tour are empty; (2) the 3-day tour is seeded with its peak-season day on Skye; from mid-October to late March that day is Sligachan, Fairy Pools, Portree, Fairy Glen, Quiraing, Kilt Rock and the Storr, and the model has no seasonal itineraries yet; (3) there is also a Glasgow departure sold as a separate product; (4) Loch Ness Bus has no booking pages yet, so its offer links to the brand's home page.

tours.title: Isle of Skye and the Highlands, 3 days from Edinburgh
tours.summary: Three days from Edinburgh with a driver-guide: Glencoe and Eilean Donan on the way, a full day on Skye, and Loch Ness and Inverness on the way back.

days.title: Edinburgh to Skye through Glencoe
days.summary: North through the Highlands by Glencoe and Fort William to the Isle of Skye. Night in or near Kyleakin.

days.title: A full day on Skye
days.summary: Dunvegan Castle, free time and lunch in Portree, then the Trotternish peninsula: the Quiraing, Kilt Rock and the Old Man of Storr. Night in or near Kyleakin.

days.title: Eilean Donan, Loch Ness and back to Edinburgh
days.summary: Eilean Donan Castle and the Five Sisters of Kintail, Loch Ness with an optional cruise and Urquhart Castle, lunch in Inverness, and south to Edinburgh.

tours.meeting_point: 190 High Street (Royal Mile), Edinburgh. Be there 15 minutes before departure.
tours.includes: Transport in an 8 to 55-seat vehicle. Professional driver-guide. Accommodation only if you book one of the packages that include it.
tours.excludes: Accommodation in the tour-only option. Entry to Dunvegan Castle, Eilean Donan Castle and the Loch Ness cruise with Urquhart Castle. Meals. Travel insurance.

tours.title: Isle of Skye and the Highlands, 2 days from Edinburgh
tours.summary: Two days from Edinburgh with a driver-guide: Eilean Donan, Sligachan and Portree on day one; Kilt Rock, the Storr, Loch Ness and Inverness on day two.

days.title: Edinburgh to Portree
days.summary: Dunkeld and Spean Bridge on the way north, a lunch stop at Eilean Donan Castle, then over the Skye Bridge to Sligachan and the Cuillin, and on to Portree.

days.title: Trotternish, Loch Ness and back to Edinburgh
days.summary: Lealt Falls, Kilt Rock and the Old Man of Storr in the morning, then Dornie, Urquhart Castle on Loch Ness, Inverness and Pitlochry. Back in Edinburgh around 20:00–21:00.

tours.meeting_point: 190 High Street (Royal Mile), Edinburgh. Be there 15 minutes before departure.
tours.includes: Transport in an 8 to 55-seat vehicle. Professional driver-guide. Entry to Urquhart Castle. Accommodation only if you book one of the packages that include it.
tours.excludes: Accommodation in the tour-only option. Entry to other attractions. Loch Ness cruise. Meals. Travel insurance.
